targetNotMet.note: Every code-side lever is in place and verified: a head preload whose candidate set matches the picture element AVIF source byte-for-byte, AVIF plus WebP with AVIF at 15KB against WebP 29KB at 960w, fetchpriority high, eager loading, no render-blocking JS, TBT 0ms. Observed LCP subparts total about 56ms; the 1.7s figure is Lighthouse throttling model, dominated by FCP at 1.1s. The runbook specifies WebPageTest 4G Moto-class for this gate, which needs the deployed preview URL and real photography to mean anything.

deliberateTradeOffs: network-dependency-tree-insight scores 0 on every page. The critical chain is document then inter-600-latin.woff2 at 24.7KB, discovered from the inlined CSS rather than preloaded. Left alone on purpose: the LCP element is the hero image, and a fourth font preload would compete with the hero AVIF for bandwidth and make LCP worse, not better. font-display swap means semibold text paints in the fallback first. Trimming that subset further is M9 work.

build.inlineStylesheets is always, so each page carries every component style it uses in the head — 27KB gzipped for the whole document. Moving CSS to an external file would save bytes on repeat views but costs a round trip on the first, which is the visit that decides LCP.
